name: Add Spice to Taste
body:
w

More peppers!

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level culinarian.

Benefit(s): Once per meal, you can add a spicy flavor profile as an additional ingredient when creating a meal. If you do, the completed dish either deals 1d6 burn damage to creatures that consume it or grants fire resistance 5 for up to 1 round per culinarian level. Each round on its turn, the subject may attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + half your culinarian level + your Intelligence modifier) or drink at least 8 oz. of milk as a move action to end the effect.
